summary: A clinician may read a patient in their own clinic. No one else may.
expected_authorization: Callers who are not clinicians are rejected.
A clinician in clinic-a may read patient p-100 (Alex Rivera).
A clinician in clinic-a must not read patient p-200 (Jordan Blake, clinic-b).
A clinician in clinic-b must not read patient p-100.
Patient ids must match p-###. Malicious ids are rejected.
Logs must not include dates of birth, MRNs, or credentials.
Source must not contain hardcoded credentials or string-built SQL.
out_of_scope: These requirements are a hackathon control set. Meeting them is not a HIPAA determination.
